summary: Triple Flag Precious Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K with its MD&A and interim financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes certifications and is incorporated by reference into its registration statements. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, spin-off, tender offer, going-private, or similar event is disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic report required under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 for foreign private issuers. There are no deal terms, no board recommendations, and no event-driven catalyst to analyze. Accordingly, this is not a special-situation filing.
